testSteps.action: Verify both return same template data
testSteps.validation: Compare Redis and SurrealDB results - should be identical
API should return template loaded from SurrealDB

externalValidationHarness.automatedTestScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Clearing storage...'
redis-cli FLUSHALL
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/sql -d 'DELETE activity_template'
echo 'Creating template...'
VARIANT_ID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8081/v2/activities/templates -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"test-template","description":"test","task_steps":[]}' | jq -r '.variant_id')
echo "Template created: $VARIANT_ID"
echo 'Checking SurrealDB...'
SDB_COUNT=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/sql -d "SELECT * FROM activity_template WHERE variant_id = '$VARIANT_ID'" | jq '.result | length')
if [ "$SDB_COUNT" -eq "0" ]; then
  echo '❌ FAILED: Template not in SurrealDB'
  exit 1
fi
echo '✓ Template found in SurrealDB'
echo 'Flushing Redis...'
redis-cli FLUSHALL
echo 'Retrieving template from API...'
API_RESULT=$(curl -s http://localhost:8081/v2/activities/templates/$VARIANT_ID)
if echo "$API_RESULT" | jq -e '.variant_id' > /dev/null; then
  echo '✓ Template retrieved from SurrealDB after cache flush'
else
  echo '❌ FAILED: Template not retrievable after cache flush'
  exit 1
fi
echo '✅ ALL TESTS PASSED'
